arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-vpsflows.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/VPS.git "$tmp/vps"
cd "$tmp/vps"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
names=['.github/workflows/cloud-supervisor-observation.yml','.github/workflows/telegram-codex-gateway.yml','.github/workflows/telegram-coordinator-owner.yml','.github/workflows/coordinator-owner-order.yml','.github/workflows/codex-chatgpt-bridge.yml','ops/coordinator_supervisor.py','ops/telegram_gateway.py','ops/supervisor_cloud_source.py']
for name in names:
 p=Path(name)
 if not p.exists():continue
 lines=p.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()
 print('FILE',name,'LINES',len(lines),flush=True)
 needles=r'(?i)(^on:|^  (push|issues|workflow_run|schedule|workflow_dispatch|repository_dispatch|pull_request):|telegram|supervisor|coordinator|codex|workflow|api.github|send_message|sendMessage|issue|actor|gh api)'
 choices=[(i+1,line) for i,line in enumerate(lines) if re.search(needles,line)]
 for i,line in choices[:17]:print('L',i,line.strip()[:160],flush=True)
PY
python3 -m unittest ops.tests.test_supervisor_passive_notifications ops.tests.test_supervisor_cloud_source -q
echo SUPERVISOR_OFFLINE_TESTS_PASS
echo SUPERVISOR_GATEWAY_AUDIT_PASS
